text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ines Fujin and I head to Kyoto to watch the spring Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As if in response to the fervent cheers, the Mejiro racers put on a spectacular performance. There's no mistaking the aura of those accustomed to expectations.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ines watches closely. Sensing that Mejiro Ryan is on another level from her, she begins to seriously consider the way she engages with her supporters.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In part to determine whether she has what it takes to reach Ryan's level, Ines decides to throw herself into training for the Takarazuka Kinen!
